fallbackName.notes: Fills the {name} merge field of an automated flow message when the customer has no usable first name. The English flow path sends the same fallback (utils/flowScheduler.js, utils/flowTriggers/*).

fallbackItem.notes: Fills the {item} merge field when a promotion has no product or service. Same fallback the English path sends (shared/operations.js buildPromoEntryNodeParams).

pointsOne.notes: Points price of a promotion, exactly one point. Arabic number agreement (CLDR): 1 = نقطة واحدة, 2 = نقطتان, 3-10 = نقاط, 11+ = نقطة.

pointsTwo.notes: Points price of a promotion, exactly two points.

pointsFew.notes: Points price whose last two digits are 3 to 10 (3, 4 ... 10, 103 ...).

pointsMany.notes: Points price for every other count (0, 11 to 99, 100, 101, 102, 111 ...).

templateNameFallback.notes: Default name of the language-versions template created for a flow message whose flow/promotion has no name (never expected in practice: both names are required fields).

fallbackService.notes: Fills the {service} merge field of a booking no-show flow message (and of an Arabic follow-up of it) when the booked service has no name. The English path sends the same fallback (utils/flowTriggers/bookingNoShow.js). Glossary: Booking = حجز.
